subject.title: feature request: `chat.history` should support a visible-only filter so `limit` can count conversation messages instead of transcript rows

question: What public `chat.history` view and pagination contract should companion clients use for user-visible conversation history?
rationale: The choice affects the shared gateway protocol, cursor stability, payload compatibility, and bounded-history performance; source evidence cannot determine whether maintainers prefer a general view mode, a narrow boolean, or raw-only pagination.

options.title: Add typed conversation view
options.body: Introduce an additive `view: "conversation"` mode with visible-message counting and stable cursor semantics while retaining the current default transcript view.

options.title: Add visible-only boolean
options.body: Implement the proposed `visibleOnly` flag narrowly, document its interaction with offset pagination, and keep mixed-message content intact by default.

options.title: Keep raw pagination only
options.body: Leave the server contract unchanged and require clients to page and aggregate raw history, accepting the documented bandwidth and shallow-page UX cost.

recommendation.title: Add typed conversation view
recommendation.body: Introduce an additive `view: "conversation"` mode with visible-message counting and stable cursor semantics while retaining the current default transcript view.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision changes a shared gateway protocol and the bounded history implementation most closely associated with this owner’s prior work.
